{{Top|leg}}
An '''academician'''<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> or '''academian'''<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> was an individual who was part of an academy. Academician was a title held by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> "[[Academician of Popular Studies]]" was a title held by [[Thunys Albegron]].<ref name="EGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
On Earth, "[[Wikipedia:academician|academician]]" can be either an honorary title denoting a full member of an art, literary, or scientific academy, or a functional title denoting a full member of the National Academy of Sciences in countries where the Academy is influential. Whether Na'al held the title merely as an honorific, or as a functional title for a new position he was holding, is unknown.
